author: Bobby Grayson
description: 1) deciduous sync -> docs/graph-data.json full snapshot (1MB, local ids, rewritten every run). 2) events: per-author JSONL in .deciduous/sync/events + monolithic checkpoint.json. 3) diff export/apply patches in .deciduous/patches (CLI removed, docs/templates still describe it, two dead patch files tracked). 4) HTTP API daemon with per-graph SQLite. Real JSONL on disk has 620 lines, 27 corrupted by interleaved concurrent appends, which makes 'events rebuild' fail entirely. MCP add_node/link_nodes (the path Claude uses most) never emit events; prompt/commit updates never emit; unlink emits a wrong edge_id.
title: Four overlapping sync mechanisms exist today
